audit.whatIsWrong: Content repeatedly claims Golden Eclipse (R) 'reflects' the Death Mark burst (whys[6], spikes[1], spikes[3], late, wants.you[1]) — Mel's R has no reflect; that is Rebuttal (W), whose barrier prevents damage while active. audit.why: Kit texts: Mel R strikes marked enemies per stacks; Mel W reflects projectiles AND prevents her taking damage. Zed's only projectile is Razor Shuriken; Living Shadow, Shadow Slash and the R dive are not reflectable, and the R dive is untargetable.
audit.corrected: Every reflect-with-R claim moved to Rebuttal-blanks-the-burst; the fake E name fixed; projectile split stated in dontsFull[2].d.

edits.before: Zed wins by landing Death Mark, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Zed wins by chunking you with shadow double-Q, then deleting the chipped bar with Death Mark's untargetable dive.

edits.before: - Zed Death Mark: matchup-defining — The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rebuttal has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Zed Death Mark: 120s at rank 1 — the all-in; the dive is untargetable, so spend your answer AFTER the mark lands. - Living Shadow is 20s at rank 1: with W down he has no gap-close and no escape — that's your trade window. - Razor Shuriken cycles every 6s.

edits.after: Living Shadow, Shadow Slash and the Death Mark dive aren't projectiles — Rebuttal reflects only shurikens; time it for the damage, not the spell.

edits.before: This is Zed's window and you have to respect it. Once he has Q Razor Shuriken plus W Living Shadow and E Contempt of the Shadows, he can double-Q you through the shadow for huge poke and slow you with E for the follow-up. Your Rebuttal only shields a short window, so if you get caught out of position his shadow-poke chunks you below his all-in threshold. Farm safe, hold E Solar Snare purely defensively for his W-dash, and don't walk up for CS while both his shadows are loaded.
edits.after: This is Zed's window and you have to respect it. Once he has Q Razor Shuriken plus W Living Shadow and E Shadow Slash, he can double-Q you through the shadow for huge poke and slow you with E for the follow-up. Your Rebuttal only shields a short window, so if you get caught out of position his shadow-poke chunks you below his all-in threshold. Farm safe, hold E Solar Snare purely defensively for his W-dash, and don't walk up for CS while both his shadows are loaded.

edits.before: Zed's 6 is the scariest point in the lane: his R Death Mark ults onto you, marks you, and the shadow-Q burst detonates for a kill if you're low. Golden Eclipse can save you here — reflect his mark damage — but the timing is tight and if he baits your R first he kills you clean. Buy early Seeker's or a Verdant Barrier component and never sit at half health with his ult available.
edits.after: Zed's 6 is the scariest point in the lane: his R Death Mark ults onto you, marks you, and the shadow-Q burst detonates for a kill if you're low. Rebuttal can save you here — the barrier blanks the burst while it lasts — but the timing is tight and if he baits your W first he kills you clean. Buy early Seeker's or a Verdant Barrier component and never sit at half health with his ult available.

edits.before: Once you have two-plus items the matchup swings back to you: teamfights let you hold Golden Eclipse for his R engage and reflect the Death Mark burst back onto him. Zed diving your backline commits his shadow and W, and a clean Solar Snare peels him off before his mark detonates. Group, don't duel — sidelane isolation is where he still beats you.
edits.after: Once you have two-plus items the matchup swings back to you: teamfights let you hold Rebuttal for his R engage and blank the Death Mark burst as it detonates. Zed diving your backline commits his shadow and W, and a clean Solar Snare peels him off before his mark detonates. Group, don't duel — sidelane isolation is where he still beats you.

edits.before: Two items plus and you climb back ahead: in grouped fights Golden Eclipse reflects his Death Mark burst and your snare peels his all-in off your carries. Zed has to isolate you in a sidelane to win now, so never give him that — group, hold R for his engage, and turn his own combo against him. The extended, multi-person fight is where Mel's reflect-and-execute kit finally out-scales his single-target burst.
edits.after: Two items plus and you climb back ahead: in grouped fights Rebuttal blanks his Death Mark burst and your snare peels his all-in off your carries. Zed has to isolate you in a sidelane to win now, so never give him that — group, hold W for his engage, and let Golden Eclipse execute what the barrier saves. The extended, multi-person fight is where Mel's block-and-execute kit finally out-scales his single-target burst.

notes: Confirmed the packet suspectName: 'Golden Eclipse reflects Death Mark' was wrong in five places — Mel's R never reflects; the save is Rebuttal (W), whose barrier prevents all damage while active (kit text), so 'blank the detonation' is the honest phrasing. Fabricated 'E Contempt of the Shadows' fixed to Shadow Slash (Contempt for the Weak is his passive). Full 'Skill' chart aligned to the agreeing content+packet chart via side-alone edits. One caveat for a human: whether a well-timed Rebuttal fully negates the mark's pop is inferred from W's blanket damage-prevention text, not separately verified frame-by-frame.
